title: Expression of TCF3 target genes defines a subclass of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma characterized by up-regulation of MYC target genes and poor clinical outcome following R-CHOP therapy.
authors: Tyryshkin, Kathrin; Moore, Alison; Good, David; Popov, Jesse; Crocker, Susan; Rauh, Michael J; Baetz, Tara; LeBrun, David P
one_liner_zh: 该文利用TCF3靶基因表达模式对弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤进行分子分型并预测预后，虽涉及转录因子TCF3，但核心是临床预后分类而非TF-DNA结合互作机制，且方法仅为表达聚类与机器学习分类，无AI/物理模拟建模，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: TCF3 is a lymphopoietic transcription factor that acquires somatic driver mutations in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL). Hypothesizing that expression patterns of TCF3-regulated genes can inform clinical management, we found that unsupervised clustering analysis with 15 TCF3-regulated genes and eight additional ones resolved local DLBCL cases into two main clusters, denoted Groups A and B, of which Group A manifested inferior overall survival (OS, p = 0.0005). We trained a machine learning model to classify samples into the Groups based on expression of the 23 transcripts in an independent validation cohort of 569 R-CHOP-treated DLBCL cases. Group A overlapped with the ABC cell-of-origin subgroup but its prognostic power was superior. GSEA analysis demonstrated asymmetric expression of 30 gene sets between the Groups, pointing to biological differences. We present, validate and make available a novel method to assign DLBCL cases into biologically-distinct groups with divergent OS following R-CHOP therapy.
abstract_zh: TCF3是一种淋巴造血转录因子，在弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）中获得体细胞驱动突变。基于TCF3调控基因的表达模式可为临床管理提供信息的假设，我们发现，使用15个TCF3调控基因及另外8个基因进行无监督聚类分析，将本地DLBCL病例分为两个主要聚类，分别命名为A组和B组，其中A组表现出较差的总生存期（OS，p = 0.0005）。我们训练了一个机器学习模型，基于23个转录本的表达，在一个包含569例接受R-CHOP治疗的DLBCL病例的独立验证队列中对样本进行分类。A组与ABC细胞起源亚型重叠，但其预后能力更优。GSEA分析显示，两组间有30个基因集存在不对称表达，提示生物学差异。我们提出、验证并提供了一种新方法，用于将DLBCL病例分为生物学上不同的组别，这些组别在R-CHOP治疗后具有不同的OS。
